entities.summary: The Iglesia del Dios Vivo, Columna y Apoyo de la Verdad, La Luz del Mundo —or simply La Luz del Mundo (LLDM)—is a Christian denomination in the nontrinitarian tradition, with its international headquarters in Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico. La Luz del Mundo practices a form of Restorationist theology centered on three leaders: Aarón—born Eusebio—Joaquín González, Samuel Joaquín Flores, and Naasón Joaquín García, who are regarded by the church as modern-day apostles of Jesus Christ.
